finding: System proxy is enabled. The bypass list covers localhost, 127.*, 10.*, 172.16-31.* and 192.168.* but NOT 100.87.190.44 (the Tailscale address). urllib therefore routes the Tailscale endpoint through 127.0.0.1:7890, which answers 502 Bad Gateway. curl does not read the Windows registry proxy, which is why curl succeeded on the same URL at the same time.
consequence: Two runs of the same client against the same server differ only by destination address: 127.0.0.1 -> 20/20 PASS; 100.87.190.44 without no_proxy -> first call 502 after 7.6 s and FSM fallback; 100.87.190.44 with no_proxy=100.87.190.44 -> 20/20 PASS.
same_root_cause_as: issue #33 comment 2026-10-17: GET /health via environment proxy returned HTTP503
